coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review PKGBUILD during main audit phase due to API error (HTTP 400)
learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should trigger automatic retries before marking a file as inconclusive, to avoid unnecessary escalations
When one model fails due to a tool error and another succeeds with a clear verdict on the same files, the successful review should be sufficient to resolve the package without re-audit
The audit system should distinguish between 'inconclusive due to security concerns' and 'inconclusive due to tool failure' in its escalation logic
